# Workspace icons

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hugeicons/core-free-icons/v/4.4.0

Official Hugeicons free Stroke Rounded assets, vendored as SVG markup to keep this app dependency-free. Geometry, stroke widths and rounded joins are unchanged. License: MIT (see LICENSE.md).

| Tab | Official icon |
| --- | --- |
| AI Assistance | AiChat02Icon |
| AI Document Validator | AiScanTextIcon |
| Forecasts | AnalyticsUpIcon |
| Data quality | DatabaseSearchIcon |
| Administration | AiSettingIcon |
